ambiguities.text: The specification does not describe what happens if a light client receives a Deneb-format header but expects a pre-Deneb format.
ambiguities.resolution_strategy: Assume that light clients must be upgraded to understand Deneb headers after the fork epoch. The P2P interface layer handles fork-specific deserialization.

implicit_assumptions.description: Full nodes honestly populate the blob_gas_used and excess_blob_gas fields in light client headers from the actual execution payload.
implicit_assumptions.impact_if_false: Light clients could receive manipulated blob gas data, leading to incorrect fee estimation or misjudgment of network blob utilization.

implicit_assumptions.description: The Deneb fork epoch is configured identically across all nodes in the network.
implicit_assumptions.impact_if_false: Mismatched fork epochs would cause some nodes to include blob gas fields while others don't, breaking light client sync across the fork boundary.
